box.why: square 20px div.chakra-checkbox__control whose paint changes unchecked → checked (bg rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) → rgba(24, 24, 27, 1))

glyph.why: svg 14px×14px present in the checked combo

glyphPath.why: polyline inside the svg, stroke rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) 3px, d=none — a polyline's points are not a computed channel: cite the glyph from the package with --glyph

row.why: nearest common ancestor of box and label: label display flex, column-gap 10px, align-items center

hit.why: no larger square parent; the box is its own hit area

dash.why: path in the indeterminate combo draws d=path("M 5 12 H 19") — a stroked line: its width/height/radius are not channels, give --set with the lowering
